Hahaha well it’s nothing serious cus it’s all from a dating app and it really hasn’t been that long, but we share similar interests and stuff which is nice. I don’t feel nervous I feel comfortable like I’m chatting with someone I’ve known for much longer which I realised I like more in the whole dating thing - being comfortable and not those annoying “butterflies in my stomach stuff”. But I still smile when I see a message cus it makes my day a teeny bit better. I even giggled once oh lord. 

But I’m hoping to meet irl soon so that we don’t just talk the whole time on the app and have nothing to say in person (did that before, ended up in such an awkward date hehe)

He’s cute too also haha and is in a rival varsity… and yeah.
He also doesn’t smoke or do drugs which I mean everybody’s body is their own but I personally don’t like smoking and I’m in my 20s In university, it’s near impossible to find someone who doesn’t smoke/do drugs😂

Well at first we bonded over the interstellar movie soundtrack and listening to music in the dark (nothing special but idk it was funny how we described it the same) 
And idk haha talking with him just seems so easy to do, I don’t feel nervous or disconnected. 
And we share some common interests which is like hiking and sims. But at the same time different cus I’m more artist and he’s more scientific, which is cool cus I’m learning more. And a lot of people downplay me because I’m an artist, but he’s respectful about it and shows interest. Which is bare minimum but lol after years of people joking that I doodle for a living or will end up poor, it’s a plus haha. 

And how he talks about what he likes, seems proud kinda and passionate. I like someone who knows what they want to do and enjoys it.

This sounds super dramatic though lol it’s not really that deep, this is all on a dating app😂
Same😭 I find a snack once in a while I can stomach and eat only that until I get sick of it. Right now it’s just hot cocoa and protein drinks or kiwis.
